reason: The p=1 jet query does not specify the parameter-augmented endpoint box, and two algorithms have circular justified_by edges to their own soundness theorems. These remain unresolved at the final review.

findings.reason: For p>0, q=(x,μ) varies over X×Λ, but the period-column query is stated on X_T×{I_d}×Θ, omitting Λ and the augmented identity dimension. The endpoint field enclosure needed for DG over the full input box is therefore unspecified. State the query on an endpoint box including Λ and the matching d+p augmented variational block. This affects section-mode consumers alg-validated-periodic-orbit-corrector and alg-periodic-orbit-pseudoarclength-continuation.

Its justified_by points to thm-validated-periodic-orbit-certificate-soundness, whose deps include this algorithm. A soundness theorem assuming the algorithm's output cannot independently justify the algorithm's well-definedness; the owner must remove or replace this cycle. Affected consumers include alg-periodic-orbit-pseudoarclength-continuation, thm-validated-periodic-orbit-certificate-soundness, thm-orbital-stability-from-certified-floquet-multipliers, ex-near-unit-floquet-multiplier-is-inconclusive, and ex-van-der-pol-stability-conditional-on-validated-enclosure.

Its justified_by points to thm-floquet-multiplier-cluster-certificate-soundness, whose deps include this algorithm. The owner must remove or replace this circular justification. Affected consumers include thm-floquet-multiplier-cluster-certificate-soundness, thm-orbital-stability-from-certified-floquet-multipliers, ex-near-unit-floquet-multiplier-is-inconclusive, and ex-van-der-pol-stability-conditional-on-validated-enclosure.

consumer_checks.reason: Its p=1 section mode relies on the unspecified augmented endpoint query; its fixed-parameter mode matches the corrected dimensions.
Its section-mode corrector call uses p=1 and inherits the jet endpoint-box gap; its one-parameter dimensions otherwise match.
Its fixed-mode use matches the corrected interface, but the corrector and this soundness theorem have a circular justified_by/dependency edge.
Its proof uses the certifier, which also points back to this theorem under justified_by.
It depends on both certificate soundness chains with unresolved algorithm/theorem cycles.
Its cluster-count and stability-theorem uses inherit the unresolved cluster-certifier cycle.
Its conditional conclusion uses both unresolved orbit and Floquet certificate soundness chains.
